claims.statement: TermuxService operates as an Android foreground service with a persistent notification to prevent process termination and maintain background shell sessions.
TermuxService implements dual client session management, switching between TermuxTerminalSessionActivityClient and TermuxTerminalSessionServiceClient when TermuxActivity is created or destroyed.
TermuxService exposes notification action intents to stop the service, acquire, and release PowerManager.WakeLock and WifiManager.WifiLock instances.
